items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Hershey Kaye got me involved in it and the first one turned out to be a hit, Milk and Honey... caused my breakup with Hershey Kaye

ctx.x: That's true of a lot of areas of the music business. I have found that everything has their own little cubicle that they're interested in.

Hershey Kaye got me involved in it and the first one turned out to be a hit, Milk and Honey, and he showed me how to do it. So it got the kids through college and it's more or less supplied us with this home, although we still don't own it, it will be couple more years.
You're pretty close though; that's good.
